title: SOC 2 GRC data model
description: Stable, query-worthy GRC metadata. Variable procedures, questionnaires, observations, rationale, and detailed results belong in Markdown through contentPath or notesPath.

person.title: Person
person.description: A workforce member or internal participant, with minimal personal data.

service-account.title: Service account
service-account.description: A non-human identity used by automation or an application.

team.title: Team
team.description: A committee, response team, or accountable group.

system.title: System
system.description: A logical application, service, infrastructure, or business-system boundary.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An individually managed physical or logical item.

document.title: Document
document.description: A governed charter, plan, procedure, standard, agreement, report, or template.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Supporting material and the metadata needed to use it in an audit.

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.description: A criterion or requirement within a framework.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: A service commitment, system requirement, or business objective.

complementary-control.title: Complementary control
complementary-control.description: A control operated by a customer or subservice organization.

control-test.title: Control test
control-test.description: A point-in-time or period test of one control.

finding.title: Finding
finding.description: An audit exception, deficiency, review issue, or other tracked gap.

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: An approved, time-bound departure from an expected control or policy.

action-item.title: Action item
action-item.description: Follow-up work from a GRC activity or finding.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: A governed policy and its Markdown content.

policy-review.title: Policy review
policy-review.description: A review of policies or other governed documents.

attestation.title: Attestation
attestation.description: A person's acknowledgement, training completion, or certification.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Governance meeting metadata, minutes, decisions, and actions.

training.title: Training
training.description: Reusable training content and assignment rules.

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: A risk and its response lifecycle.

risk-assessment.title: Risk assessment
risk-assessment.description: A point-in-time assessment of a risk scope.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: A third party that provides a product or service.

vendor-review.title: Vendor review
vendor-review.description: Vendor due diligence or periodic review.

access-grant.title: Access grant
access-grant.description: One person's or service account's access to one system.

access-review.title: Access review
access-review.description: A point-in-time review of system access.

vulnerability.title: Vulnerability
vulnerability.description: A security weakness or grouped set of weaknesses.

vulnerability-scan.title: Vulnerability scan
vulnerability-scan.description: A vulnerability scan activity and its coverage.

incident.title: Incident
incident.description: A suspected or confirmed security or privacy incident.

exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.description: A continuity, recovery, incident, privacy, or other simulation.

penetration-test.title: Penetration test
penetration-test.description: An internal or external penetration test.

data-request.title: Data request
data-request.description: A privacy or contractual request concerning data.

audit-request.title: Audit request
audit-request.description: One auditor request or prepared-by-client item.
